item.tib: byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i 'grel pa
item.skt: bo d+hi sat+wa b+hU mi br-it+ti
item.coloph: sbyin pa rim par phye ba ste dgu pa rdzogs so/ tshul khrims rim par phye ba ni gong du phyung ba yin/ slob dpon yon tan 'do kyis mdzad pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i 'grel pa las ji snyed 'gyur ba rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dI paM ka ra shrI dz+nyA na dang / lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ rgya gar gyi dpe bying nas yi ge ma mthong bas 'phro lus te da dung bam po bdun tsam yod do
